stepBody: Only type what is in the blank, do not include what is provided. Do not use spaces unless absolutely necessary. Please use double quotes (" "), instead of single quotes (' ').##figure4.gif##

figureAlts.figure4.gif: Tiffany has a bag with three marbles: one orange and two purple. She draws from the bag 10 times with replacement, winning by drawing at least one orange marble. The task is to write a function to simulate one round of Tiffany’s game, returning True if she wins and False if she loses. A fill-in-the-blank code block defines the function one_round. Inside, bag is assigned Blank 1, one_sim is assigned Blank 2, num_orange is assigned Blank 3, and the function returns Blank 4.
